svg.title: A-101 First Floor Plan
svg.text: LEVEL +3.00 · SCALE 1:50 @ A1 · ALL DIMENSIONS IN METRES
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm partition, 300 mm external / party
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab over)
1. The front terrace and the master balcony are enclosed by a 1.10 m high
parapet pierced by traditional arched brick openings; arch heads are shown
2. Terrace finish is 30 mm below internal floor level, falling 1:80 to
3. The master suite occupies block B with the bedroom on the garden side; the
dressing room is daylit from the light court.
4. East boundary openings: the adjoining plot is limited to 3.00 m in height,
so the east wall is opened above that level. The master bedroom cross
ventilates between the balcony and its east window, and the ensuite and
5. Openings in a boundary wall are subject to local fire separation and
rights of light rules; confirm before construction.
6. All bedroom doors give 900 mm clear opening, and the landing holds a 1.10
m clear route to the stair.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction. Do not scale from this drawing;
work to figured dimensions only and verify all levels and site boundaries before work.
